additional_original_rules_generalised.js.note: 5 confirmed-clean status pairs x 3 grammar types x 4 real topics (pulled from veerlosar's actual file) = 60 per category. cultural_categories_verified_en.json.note: 5 cultural categories x 2 clause wordings x 4 topics x 5 status pairs x 3 grammar types = 120 each. Topics: medical, mental_health, legal, general -- no finance. All checkers are LLM-judge (no regex exists for tone/humor/directness/humility/emotion judgments).

cultural_imperative_declarative_en.json.note: All 30 queries per category individually authored, checked for duplicates within category before counting.

original_imperative_declarative_en.json.note: Imperative ('write 5 words') vs declarative ('5 words are written') mood contrast, no status tag -- the axis veerlosar/nuna originally proposed, not covered by the earlier 120-row sets (which varied status-word and register, never mood). Provenance per category noted below.

metadata.note: Turkish translation. check_native=False marks pairs whose query/answer used the systematic fallback and want a native review. Note: Turkish has no definite article, so the single_word "no articles" rule is near-trivially satisfied.
